rule.name: JpaUnindexedForeignKey
rule.message: Add @Index(columnList = "<join column>") to the entity''s @Table(indexes = ...) for the join column of this @ManyToOne. Only MySQL indexes a foreign key by itself; on PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite every join and delete through it scans the table.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $norm := function($name) { lower-case(replace(string($name), '[_\s`"\[\]]', '')) }, $first := function($list) { $norm(tokenize(normalize-space(tokenize(string($list), ',')[1]), ' ')[1]) } return //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.ManyToOne') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.ManyToOne')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MapsId') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MapsId') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.JoinTable') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.JoinTable')])] [let $ids := ../FieldDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Id') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Id')]] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name ! string(.), $field := string(VariableDeclarator[1]/VariableId/@Name), $join := (ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.JoinColumn')] | ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.JoinColumns') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.JoinColumns')] //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.JoinColumn')])[1], $named := $join/AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'name'], $table := ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Table') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Table')], $lists := $table//Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Index') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Index')] /AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'columnList']/*, $uniques := $table//Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.UniqueConstraint') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.UniqueConstraint')] /AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'columnNames']/(StringLiteral | MemberValueArrayInitializer/*[1]), $leads := ($lists[self::StringLiteral]/@ConstValue ! $first(.), $uniques[self::StringLiteral]/@ConstValue ! $norm(.)), $column := $named/StringLiteral/@ConstValue ! $norm(.) return not( exists($lists[not(self::StringLiteral)]) or exists($uniques[not(self::StringLiteral)]) or exists($named[not(StringLiteral)]) or exists($join/AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'unique'][BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]]) or $field = min($ids) or (if (exists($column)) then $leads = $column else some $lead in $leads satisfies starts-with($lead, $norm($field))) )]
